data.one_liner: A pure Dart implementation of the BlurHash algorithm for encoding and decoding images.
data.what_it_does: It encodes raw images into compact BlurHash string representations and decodes BlurHash strings back into placeholder images. It also provides utility extensions for computations like color averages.
use_when: You need to display low-resolution placeholder gradients while full images load.
You want to generate BlurHash strings from images on any Dart platform without platform-specific code.
avoid_when: You are looking for a complete image loading and caching library.
You need native UI widgets specifically designed for displaying blurhashes.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation supporting all Dart platforms.
Provides both encoder and decoder out of the box.
weaknesses: Decoding returns raw pixels via the 'image' package, requiring manual conversion to displayable formats in Flutter.
Computationally intensive tasks like encoding should be cached to avoid running on every build.
